## Round-2 per-clause verdicts (ba4afcc2)
Each line: item revN · clause · verdict · text oracle evidence.

- automation.trigger-status-contract rev2 · acceptance[4] (409 RESUME_IN_PROGRESS arm only) · **pass** — the race is deterministic. The scratch screen flow `qa_slow_resume` runs collect → http GET to a 6 s delay server → collect2. Resume A (`inputs{x}`) holds the engine's in-memory resume guard for about 6 s. Resume B, sent 1.5 s later, gets **409** `{"error":{"code":"RESUME_IN_PROGRESS","message":"Run 'run_…' is already being resumed","httpStatus":409}}` in 0.03–0.05 s. A read of the run right after the 409 shows `status: paused`. A then answers 200 `status: paused` at screen `collect2` with the same runId, and a later valid resume (`inputs{y}`) answers 200 `success: true`, run `completed`. A resume after completion answers 404. Reproduced twice (run_9b0acf73…, run_c6856d35…). The 503 arm was not judged (parked fixture gap, per the task).
